title: Glasshouse and Language
author: Lior Montrose
blurb: Lior Vasquez, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
